case_title: JASDEEP SINGH @ JASSU v. STATE OF PUNJAB
statutory_provisions: IPC s.304 part I and s.34
trial_court_outcome: Convicted under Section 304 part I IPC with life sentence
neutral_facts: The incident occurred at approximately 12:45 a.m. on April 21, 2011, in the area of Baba Rasoi Dhaba, Jalandhar. The deceased was involved in a dispute with the accused, who were his friends. The deceased was found grappling with the accused on a street. The deceased approached the accused, and after a confrontation, A1 took out a gun and shot the deceased. The accused were present at the scene, and there was a fight. The deceased was taken to a hospital, and the accused were later charged with culpable homicide not amounting to murder. The trial court convicted all accused under Section 304 part I IPC with life sentences, but the High Court and Supreme Court found the evidence insufficient to establish common intention for A3 and A4, leading to their acquittal.
